artifacts.summary: 5-phase implementation plan for strong completeness of minimal, intuitionistic, and classical propositional logics (480-630 lines, 6 hours)

memory_candidates.content: CSLib propositional strong completeness follows a uniform MCS/Lindenbaum pattern across minimal, intuitionistic, and classical logics. The key architectural insight is that Phases 2-4 (one per logic) are independent after shared definitions (Phase 1), enabling parallel execution. The minimal case is simplest (MinTheory has no consistency requirement), intuitionistic requires an EFQ case split on Gamma consistency, and classical requires a Peirce-based DNE argument for consistency of Gamma union {neg phi}.
